description: Who is placing the big bets on Polymarket right now? Pass a market (slug, link or condition id) or a category (its 5 busiest markets): every trade over minUsd in the last 1 to 24 hours, buys and sells per outcome, the biggest traders with their all-time P&L rank and X handle, and headlines such as "3 top-50 traders bought NO for $80k in the last 24 h". Live from Polymarket's public data. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.
